Northstar 27 USB-C Monitor Review

The Northstar 27 is a 27-inch monitor with a 2560 by 1440 IPS panel, a 90 watt USB-C charging port, and a height-adjustable stand. The single-cable connection worked reliably with the laptops in this fixture review.

Its matte screen remained readable in a bright home office, while the factory color mode looked accurate enough for ordinary photo editing. The built-in speakers are suitable for calls but sound thin for music and films.

Warranty and buying notes

The manufacturer lists a three-year limited warranty. Shoppers should verify that a listing includes the regional power cable and is sold by an authorized retailer before relying on that coverage.
